questions.question: In Jeremiah's warning to Judah, the ram's horn was blown across the land. What did the cry tell the people to do?

answers.text: March out and face the army
Gather at the temple to pray

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, the LORD said an army would surround Jerusalem like men guarding a field. Why was this happening?

answers.text: Her king had insulted the army
Her walls had been built too weak

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, the LORD told Jerusalem to wash something away so that she might be saved. What was it?
Through Jeremiah, the LORD said the land of Judah would be desolate and that He would completely finish its destruction. True or false?
